title: The Big 3
wikitext:
'''The Big 3''' or '''TB3''' is a phrase often used to describe the 3 most commonly-played maps in each game mode, mainly for [[4on4]]. 

==Maps==
===1on1/2on2===
In [[1on1]] and [[2on2]] these maps are [[dm2]], [[dm4]] and [[dm6]]. In the earlier days this was more common due to reluctance to accept new maps. In modern terminology [[TB5]] has typically taken over as the base map pool for tournaments, with the addition of [[ztndm3]] and [[aerowalk]].

===4on4===
In [[4on4]] TB3 is made up of 2 deathmatch maps - [[dm2]] and [[dm3]] - plus [[e1m2]], a map from the Quake 1 single player campaign.

|map3=e1m2
}}

==TB3 dominance in 4on4==
Debate long raged in the QW scene about whether it's better to stick to the tried and tested TB3 map pool, or whether so-called "[[Kenya]]" maps should be played in tournaments.

The 4on4 scene is traditionally dominated by TB3, with a slim minority of games being played on [[Schloss]], [[CMT3]] and [[CMT4]].  During the 2020s Schloss has established itself as the most commonly played 'Kenya' map and is frequently included in tournaments.
